args.sql:
WITH quarterly_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        clientref,
        -- Group customers into quarterly cohorts based on their tenure
        CASE 
            WHEN tenureyrs BETWEEN 0 AND 3 MONTHS THEN 'Q1'
            WHEN tenureyrs BETWEEN 4 AND 6 MONTHS THEN 'Q2'
            WHEN tenureyrs BETWEEN 7 AND 9 MONTHS THEN 'Q3'
            WHEN tenureyrs BETWEEN 10 AND 12 MONTHS THEN 'Q4'
        END AS cohort_quarter
    FROM 
        core_record
),
digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        clientref,
        -- Identify digital natives based on their digital channel habits
        CASE 
            WHEN chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' 
                 OR chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High'
                 OR chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes'
                 OR chaninvdatablock->>'depostat' = 'Yes'
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_digital_native
    FROM 
        bank_and_transactions
)

SELECT 
    qc.cohort_quarter,
    dn.is_digital_native,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.clientref) AS cohort_size,
    -- Calculate engagement score
    AVG(cr.profitscore) AS engagement_score,
    -- Calculate percentage of the cohort with high engagement
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cr.profitscore > 0.7 THEN cr.clientref END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cr.clientref)) AS high_engagement_percentage,
    -- Calculate high-engagement percentage broken down by digital native status
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cr.profitscore > 0.7 AND dn.is_digital_native THEN cr.clientref END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cr.clientref)) AS high_engagement_percentage_digital_native
FROM 
    quarterly_cohorts qc
JOIN 
    core_record cr ON qc.clientref = cr.clientref
JOIN 
    digital_natives dn ON cr.clientref = dn.clientref
GROUP BY 
    qc.cohort_quarter, dn.is_digital_native;

                 OR chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes'
                 OR chaninvdatablock->>'depostat' = 'Yes'
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_digital_native
    FROM 
        bank_and_transactions
)

SELECT 
    qc.cohort_quarter,
    dn.is_digital_native,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cr.clientref) AS cohort_size,
    -- Calculate engagement score
    AVG(cr.profitscore) AS engagement_score,
    -- Calculate percentage of the cohort with high engagement
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cr.profitscore > 0.7 THEN cr.clientref END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cr.clientref)) AS high_engagement_percentage,
    -- Calculate high-engagement percentage broken down by digital native status
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cr.profitscore > 0.7 AND dn.is_digital_native THEN cr.clientref END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cr.clientref)) AS high_engagement_percentage_digital_native
FROM 
    quarterly_cohorts qc
JOIN 
    core_record cr ON qc.clientref = cr.clientref
JOIN 
    digital_natives dn ON cr.clientref = dn.clientref
GROUP BY 
    qc.cohort_quarter, dn.is_digital_native;
